title: Fix unassigned column disappearance in Cortex, elevate modal z-indexes, and render brand app icon in splash screen
summary: 1. Retained columns without persona in cortexStore boardStages with personaName 'без агента' and preserved stage rules/hooks; enabled AgentField re-selection in CortexExplorer. 2. Replaced text delta in SplashScreen with authentic Obsidian Badge SVG matching public/favicon.svg. 3. Raised SettingsModal and ToolPolicyModal backdrops to z-[80] (and nested to z-[90]) so modals open above the AgentConsoleDrawer chat overlay (z-50).
